text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, no, no, no! Don't you worry about it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I know exactly how it feels to fail when under pressure!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: That said… I'm also kinda losing my confidence here. Maybe I should save that stuffed spider for some other time…
